name: Geimu
source:
In the near future the human genome has been completely analyzed and the production of artificial life forms, chimeras, started. Main character Alf is a cat type human who is a professional trainer. He is tasked to train cat girl Jasmine in order to make her an obedient and skillful maid.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在不久的将来，人类基因组已被完全分析，人工生命形式嵌合体的生产也开始了。主角阿尔夫是一位猫型人类，是一名职业训练师。他的任务是训练猫女茉莉，让她成为一个听话、能干的丫鬟。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
